name: sidebar
description: Case-law research and litigation work on the Sidebar connector: potential-claims, motion to dismiss and summary judgment analyses kept as files in the Claude Project, a check of the other side's brief, a pre-filing check of our own draft, an on-demand recheck of every authority in the matter, Kansas mechanic's liens with a deadline check and a document-backed support ledger for the amount, and open-ended research kept as a compounding folder of memos that new facts are applied to. The skills share a matter hub (matter.md) and a fact ledger (facts.md), and all of it is grounded in Sidebar's case-law tools.
